items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: PreToolUse hook registered, inert unless a release is in progress, blocks tag/trunk push, gh pr merge and gh release create without the record for HEAD; tested fails-on-old/passes-on-new.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Any parse or git-locate error allows; only an unreachable origin keeps a deny, deliberately; garbled payload and corrupt state tests.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No shell is spawned from command text; git runs with prompts off; guard is cooperative, documented as such; env text in the command cannot lift it.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Real git and the real producers write the state; parser table; Windows paths; false-block, stale, other-root, event-commit and revert cases.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No git call until a command is an outward candidate; network lookup only on a would-be deny with 8 s timeout.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Parser and decision split into two files under 300 lines; registry rows updated for the two shared guards.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Consumer of release_run.json and release_state.json; round-trip test uses release_runstate.save and release_commit.write_state, plus integration case.
